purpose: Notes realising the v1.30 directional labels in directed_link_eval_cases.json. Written from those labels before any scorer existed; every dependency sentence restates that case's own `evidence` field. Synthetic: no real Vault content.

notes.title: Alias Matching Design
notes.body:
## What this decides

How an alias in frontmatter resolves to the note that declares it.

## Why

The design references the scalar and list examples in [[Frontmatter Alias Examples]].

notes.title: Bilingual Query Expansion
notes.body:
## What this decides

How a query written in one language reaches notes written in the other.

## Why

Every expansion term is traced to [[Vault Terminology Table]].

notes.title: Capture Receipt Contract
notes.body:
## What this decides

What a capture receipt must bind so a note can be checked later.

## Why

Candidate identity is delegated to [[Candidate Hash Algorithm]].

notes.title: Deterministic Ranking
notes.body:
## What this decides

Why two runs over an unchanged Vault return the same order.

## Why

Equal scores are resolved by importing the path-order rule from [[Tie-break Specification]].

notes.title: Material Image Capture
notes.body:
## What this decides

When an image is material to a capture, and what to do when it is missing.

## Why

The capture flow branches on the availability states in [[Image Availability Matrix]].

notes.title: No-answer Gate
notes.body:
## What this decides

When retrieval should return nothing rather than the closest of several answers.

## Why

The gate's corpus is selected from the cases in [[False-positive Casebook]].

notes.title: Offline Search Decision
notes.body:
## What this decides

Why search runs locally rather than against a hosted index.

## Why

This decision names [[Index Privacy Threat Model]] as the privacy constraint it answers to.

notes.title: Read-only Retrieval
notes.body:
## What this decides

The guarantee that retrieval never changes a file.

## Why

Immutability is proven with the before-and-after hashes from [[Filesystem Snapshot Method]].

notes.title: Release Quality Gate
notes.body:
## What this decides

What has to hold before a release goes out.

## Why

The gate fails when any run in [[Reference Agent Runs]] has a hard failure.

notes.title: Retry Policy
notes.body:
## What this decides

How this service retries a failed call, and where the delay stops growing.

## Why

The ceiling cites the saturation point measured in [[Backoff Measurements]].

notes.title: Search Latency Budget
notes.body:
## What this decides

How slow a search is allowed to be before it counts as a regression.

## Why

The budget is expressed as a multiple of the P95 in [[Vault Scan Benchmark]].

notes.title: Semantic Candidate Order
notes.body:
## What this decides

The order candidates are considered in, and why it is not alphabetical.

## Why

Candidate priority follows the failure categories in [[Lexical Baseline Report]].

notes.title: Source Archive Format
notes.body:
## What this decides

The byte-level format an archived source is written in.

## Why

Reconstructability is verified by [[Archive Replay Test]], which consumes an archive in this format.

notes.title: Template Compatibility Policy
notes.body:
## What this decides

How this project treats a Vault whose templates differ from its own.

## Why

This policy cites the incompatible custom headings found by [[Customized Vault Survey]].

notes.title: Verified Capture Workflow
notes.body:
## What this decides

The stricter capture path, and what makes a capture verified.

## Why

The workflow links to [[Independent Audit Procedure]] for its verification stage.

notes.title: Zero-write Failure Rule
notes.body:
## What this decides

What happens when a capture cannot complete: nothing is written.

## Why

This rule was adopted in response to [[Unavailable Source Incident]].

notes.title: Archive Replay Test
notes.body:
## What this records

Replaying an archive to confirm the original can still be reconstructed byte for byte.

notes.title: Backoff Measurements
notes.body:
## What this records

Measured latency under load. Saturation appears at 800 ms; past that, added delay buys nothing.

notes.title: Candidate Hash Algorithm
notes.body:
## What this records

The hash used to identify a candidate: input normalisation, algorithm, and what a collision would mean.

notes.title: Customized Vault Survey
notes.body:
## What this records

A survey of Vaults with custom templates. Which headings differ, and how far.

notes.title: False-positive Casebook
notes.body:
## What this records

Cases where a confident answer was wrong, grouped by what produced the confidence.

notes.title: Filesystem Snapshot Method
notes.body:
## What this records

Hashing every file before and after an operation to prove nothing changed.

notes.title: Frontmatter Alias Examples
notes.body:
## What this records

Alias frontmatter as it appears in the wild: a bare scalar, a list, and the empty forms.

notes.title: Image Availability Matrix
notes.body:
## What this records

Every availability state an image can be in, and what each one permits.

notes.title: Independent Audit Procedure
notes.body:
## What this records

The second pass: who runs it, what they re-check, and what they are not allowed to see first.

notes.title: Index Privacy Threat Model
notes.body:
## What this records

What an attacker learns from a hosted index: query contents, timing, and the shape of the corpus.

notes.title: Lexical Baseline Report
notes.body:
## What this records

Where lexical ranking misses, grouped into failure categories with counts.

notes.title: Reference Agent Runs
notes.body:
## What this records

Repeated runs against the reference Vault, each recorded with its outcome.

notes.title: Tie-break Specification
notes.body:
## What this records

How equal scores are ordered: by path, case-folded first, then raw.

notes.title: Unavailable Source Incident
notes.body:
## What this records

The incident: a source went unavailable mid-capture and a half-written note was left behind.

notes.title: Vault Scan Benchmark
notes.body:
## What this records

Scan timings over a 200-note Vault. P50 and P95, measured cold and warm.

notes.title: Vault Terminology Table
notes.body:
## What this records

The bounded table of term pairs this Vault uses across its two languages.

notes.title: Airport Departure Gates
notes.body:
## What this records

How departure gates are assigned, why they change late, and how far the walk is from security.

notes.title: Camera Capture Settings
notes.body:
## What this records

Settings for capture on the camera: shutter, ISO, and the bracketing preset used indoors.

notes.title: Election Candidates
notes.body:
## What this records

The candidates standing this cycle and where each of them differs from the others.

notes.title: Empty File Cleanup
notes.body:
## What this records

A housekeeping routine that removes zero-byte files left behind by interrupted downloads.

notes.title: HTTP Client Library Survey
notes.body:
## What this records

A comparison of client libraries. Each section lists timeouts, connection pooling and whether the library retries by default.

notes.title: Image Compression Tips
notes.body:
## What this records

Getting an image smaller without visible loss: format choice, quality settings, and when to stop.

notes.title: Interview Answers
notes.body:
## What this records

Answers prepared for interview questions, with the ones that landed badly marked.

notes.title: Language Learning Schedule
notes.body:
## What this records

A weekly plan for studying two languages: which mornings go to which, and how review is spaced.

notes.title: Museum Archive Visit
notes.body:
## What this records

A visit to the museum archive. What the reading room allows, how requests are queued, and what could be photographed.

notes.title: Presentation Templates
notes.body:
## What this records

Slide templates: title layouts, the chart palette, and which template to use for an external deck.

notes.title: Quarterly Budget Notes
notes.body:
## What this records

Where the quarter's budget went. Headcount, tooling, and the line items that came in over.

notes.title: Reading List
notes.body:
## What this records

Books to read, with the ones already read struck through and a line on each.

notes.title: Receipt Printer Review
notes.body:
## What this records

A thermal receipt printer tested for a small shop. Paper cost, cutter reliability, and how legible the receipt is after a week in a wallet.

notes.title: Search Icon Design
notes.body:
## What this records

Notes on the magnifying-glass icon: stroke weight, optical size, and how the search affordance reads at 16px.

notes.title: Shell Alias Collection
notes.body:
## What this records

Aliases collected over the years. Short names for long commands, and the two that turned out to be dangerous.

notes.title: University Rankings
notes.body:
## What this records

How universities are ranked, which inputs dominate, and why the order moves so little year to year.
